label: 原脚本 BOLD 频带波动区域摘要（STD 指标）
description: Resample BOLD to the mask grid, detrend and filter at 0.01–0.1 Hz, compute temporal standard deviation and normalize that map within the mask. Summarize values and ROI centres by atlas. The source names this zALFF, but this adapter computes filtered-signal STD, not Fourier-amplitude ALFF. Inputs: bold: 原脚本所需 4D BOLD (file); atlas: 同空间分区图谱 (file); labels: 图谱标签 (file); mask: 分析掩膜 (file). Registered outputs: results/TOP_active_regions.csv, results/top_coordinates.csv, results/all_brain_regions_activity.csv.
